blocks.text: Model ban jane ke baad yeh dekhna zaroori hai ke woh kitna achha kaam karta hai aur us ke results ka matlab kya hai. Isi ko model evaluation (model ki jaanch) kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Statistical modeling mein model evaluation ka concept samjhaiye. (Long question 4)
blocks.explanation: Evaluation train kiye gaye model ko aise data par test karti hai jo us ne pehle nahi dekha, ta ke pata chale ke us ki predictions par bharosa ho sakta hai ya nahi. Error metrics naapte hain ke andaza asal se kitna door hai (stall model mein 28 customers par 30 rupay ka farq); accuracy metrics ginte hain ke haan/nahi wale andaze kitni baar sahi the (pass ya fail). Phir results samjhe jate hain, fairness (sab ke saath barabar sulook) aur privacy dekhi jati hai, aur performance kharab ho to zyada data ya behtar factors se model behtar kiya jata hai.

items: Model evaluation: model kitna achha kaam karta hai aur us ke results ka matlab kya hai.
